query:
SELECT id, email, 
  CASE WHEN passwordHash IS NOT NULL THEN 'email_user' ELSE 'oauth_user' END as user_type,
  createdAt, lastLoginAt, isVerified
FROM app_users 
WHERE email LIKE '%bayazi%' OR email LIKE '%walla%'
LIMIT 5;
